basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer and hobbyist from the Pacific Northwest with a passion for all things related to The Legend of Zelda series. I work part-time at a local electronics store and spend my free time gaming or prepping for potential emergencies. I'm single and enjoy exploring new subreddits related to my interests. I usually hop online in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have extensive self-taught knowledge about The Legend of Zelda series, having played most of the games multiple times. My expertise comes from years of gaming and engaging with online communities around the series. I also dabble in cryptocurrencies as a hobby, although not deeply invested financially.
